fusions.name: Stampede Below Decks
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you takes a trampling that deals 28 damage, 10% more for each ally near you (max +40%). Landing it makes your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Herding Goad
fusions.desc: Flicks a long goad at an enemy up to 7 tiles away; it deals 7 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Warm Hold
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally near you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Bunks
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
